title: "Figure 7: paired Green30-Target30 equity analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-08"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Production workflow for Figure 7.
#
# The 2050 temperature fields are evaluated with fixed 2021 population and
# 2021 baseline mortality. Results are therefore climate-scenario estimates,
# not projections of London's 2050 demographic composition.
#
# Green30 benefit tertiles are fixed and reused for Target30. When an LSOA
# population table is present, benefit is expressed per 100,000 residents.
# Otherwise population-weighted fields remain missing instead of silently
# treating every LSOA as having the same population.

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(biscale)
library(digest)

outcome_keep <- "All_cause"
scenario_keep <- c("Green30", "Target30")
population_year <- 2021L
temperature_period <- 2050L
bootstrap_draws <- 2000L
bootstrap_seed <- 20260908L

main_vulnerability_vars <- c("pIncomeDeprivation", "p75over", "pBAME")
# Age <5 is less directly aligned with all-cause mortality. SVI partly
# reproduces the targeting rule, so both are supplementary checks.
supplementary_vulnerability_vars <- c("p5under", "SVI")
vulnerability_vars <- c(main_vulnerability_vars, supplementary_vulnerability_vars)
vulnerability_labels <- c(
  pIncomeDeprivation = "Income deprivation",
  p5under = "Age <5",
  p75over = "Age 75+",
  pBAME = "Ethnic minority",
  SVI = "SVI"
)

output_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "URBAN_COOLING_FIG7_OUTPUT_DIR",
  unset = "./figures/equity_map_biscale_revised_equal_area"
)
population_file <- "./data/derived/lsoa_population_2021_by_lsoa11cd.csv"
health_zonal_file <- "./data/derived/health_lsoa_fig7_revised_equal_area_population_weighted_2021.csv"
green30_mc_file <- "./data/derived/green30_revised_equal_area_25c_city_total_draws_by_cause.csv"
target30_mc_file <- "./data/derived/target30_revised_equal_area_25c_city_total_draws_by_cause.csv"
svi_file <- "./data/derived/fig7_vulnerability_lsoa11_fig7_revised_equal_area.gpkg"
```

## Load and validate data

```{r load-data}
# Build the analysis object from its documented sources instead of relying on
# a previously saved RDS whose scenario and geography provenance is ambiguous.
if (!file.exists(health_zonal_file)) {
  stop("Missing revised LSOA health table: ", health_zonal_file)
}
if (!file.exists(svi_file)) {
  stop("Missing documented Figure 7 vulnerability layer: ", svi_file)
}

svi_lsoa <- read_sf(svi_file, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  rename(SVI = overall_score)
health_rows <- read_csv(health_zonal_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(
    temperature_setting_c == 25,
    cause == "all_cause",
    lc_scenario %in% scenario_keep
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    LSOA11CD, LSOA11NM, Neighborhood_name,
    indicator, lc_scenario, cases = deaths_averted,
    cases_meaning = "Deaths averted"
  )
if (nrow(health_rows) != 2 * nrow(svi_lsoa)) {
  stop("Expected exactly two 25 C all-cause rows for each LSOA.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(health_rows[c("LSOA11CD", "lc_scenario")])) {
  stop("Revised LSOA health table contains duplicate LSOA11CD/scenario pairs.")
}
health_sf <- svi_lsoa %>%
  select(-any_of(c("id", "LSOA11NM", "Neighborhood_name"))) %>%
  left_join(health_rows, by = "LSOA11CD")
if (anyNA(health_sf$cases)) {
  stop("Health results did not join completely by official LSOA11CD.")
}

required_vars <- c("LSOA11CD", "indicator", "lc_scenario", "cases", vulnerability_vars)
missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(health_sf))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in health_sf: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

# Prefer an embedded population field; otherwise use the documented lookup.
population_candidates <- c(
  "population_2021", "Population_2021", "population", "Population",
  "total_population", "pop_2021", "pop"
)
population_matches <- intersect(population_candidates, names(health_sf))
if (length(population_matches) > 1) {
  stop("Multiple candidate population columns found: ", paste(population_matches, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(population_matches) == 1) {
  population_var <- population_matches[[1]]
  health_sf <- health_sf %>%
    mutate(population_2021 = as.numeric(.data[[population_var]]))
  population_source <- paste0("health_sf$", population_var)
} else if (file.exists(population_file)) {
  population_lookup <- read_csv(population_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("LSOA11CD", "population_2021") %in% names(population_lookup))) {
    stop(population_file, " must contain LSOA11CD and population_2021 columns.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(population_lookup$LSOA11CD)) {
    stop(population_file, " contains duplicate LSOA11CD values.")
  }
  health_sf <- health_sf %>%
    left_join(
      population_lookup %>% select(LSOA11CD, population_2021),
      by = "LSOA11CD"
    )
  population_source <- population_file
} else {
  health_sf <- health_sf %>% mutate(population_2021 = NA_real_)
  population_source <- NA_character_
  warning(
    "No 2021 population lookup found. Add ", population_file,
    " with columns LSOA11CD,population_2021. Absolute-benefit results will be ",
    "retained, but population-normalized fields will be missing."
  )
}

has_population <- any(!is.na(health_sf$population_2021))
if (has_population) {
  population_check <- health_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    distinct(LSOA11CD, population_2021)
  if (anyNA(population_check$population_2021)) {
    stop("The 2021 population join is incomplete for one or more LSOAs.")
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(population_check$population_2021)) ||
      any(population_check$population_2021 <= 0)) {
    stop("population_2021 must contain finite, positive values.")
  }
}

equity_long <- health_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    indicator == outcome_keep,
    as.character(lc_scenario) %in% scenario_keep
  ) %>%
  select(LSOA11CD, lc_scenario, cases, population_2021, all_of(vulnerability_vars)) %>%
  mutate(lc_scenario = as.character(lc_scenario))

duplicate_check <- equity_long %>% count(LSOA11CD, lc_scenario) %>% filter(n != 1)
if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  stop("Each LSOA11CD must have exactly one row per scenario.")
}

pair_check <- equity_long %>% count(LSOA11CD) %>% filter(n != length(scenario_keep))
if (nrow(pair_check) > 0) {
  stop(nrow(pair_check), " LSOAs do not have both Green30 and Target30.")
}

equity_wide <- equity_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(LSOA11CD, population_2021, all_of(vulnerability_vars)),
    names_from = lc_scenario,
    values_from = cases,
    names_prefix = "cases_"
  )
if (anyNA(equity_wide[, c("cases_Green30", "cases_Target30")])) {
  stop("Missing mortality-benefit values remain after pairing scenarios.")
}

equity_wide <- equity_wide %>%
  mutate(
    delta_cases = cases_Target30 - cases_Green30,
    benefit_Green30 = if (has_population) 100000 * cases_Green30 / population_2021 else cases_Green30,
    benefit_Target30 = if (has_population) 100000 * cases_Target30 / population_2021 else cases_Target30,
    delta_benefit = benefit_Target30 - benefit_Green30
  )
benefit_unit <- if (has_population) {
  "Deaths averted per 100,000 residents (2021 population)"
} else {
  "Absolute deaths averted per LSOA (population denominator pending)"
}
```

## Fixed classifications and paired summaries

```{r paired-analysis}
green30_benefit_breaks <- quantile(
  equity_wide$benefit_Green30, c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 7
)
if (length(unique(green30_benefit_breaks)) != 2) {
  stop("Green30 benefit tertiles are not distinct.")
}

classify_tertile <- function(x, breaks) {
  case_when(x <= breaks[1] ~ 1L, x <= breaks[2] ~ 2L, TRUE ~ 3L)
}
benefit_levels <- c("Low", "Moderate", "High")

metric_data <- map_dfr(vulnerability_vars, function(metric_name) {
  vulnerability_breaks <- quantile(
    equity_wide[[metric_name]], c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
    na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 7
  )
  equity_wide %>%
    transmute(
      LSOA11CD,
      metric = metric_name,
      metric_label = unname(vulnerability_labels[metric_name]),
      vulnerability = .data[[metric_name]],
      vulnerability_class = classify_tertile(vulnerability, vulnerability_breaks),
      high_vulnerability = vulnerability_class == 3L,
      population_2021,
      cases_Green30, cases_Target30, delta_cases,
      benefit_Green30, benefit_Target30, delta_benefit,
      benefit_class_Green30 = classify_tertile(benefit_Green30, green30_benefit_breaks),
      benefit_class_Target30 = classify_tertile(benefit_Target30, green30_benefit_breaks),
      benefit_Green30_group = factor(
        benefit_levels[benefit_class_Green30], levels = benefit_levels
      ),
      benefit_Target30_group = factor(
        benefit_levels[benefit_class_Target30], levels = benefit_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(vulnerability), !is.na(high_vulnerability))
})

headline_results <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability) %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_high_vulnerability = n(),
    n_blue_Green30 = sum(benefit_Green30_group == "Low"),
    n_blue_Target30 = sum(benefit_Target30_group == "Low"),
    pct_blue_Green30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Green30_group == "Low"),
    pct_blue_Target30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Target30_group == "Low"),
    change_blue_percentage_points = pct_blue_Target30 - pct_blue_Green30,
    n_blue_resolved = sum(benefit_Green30_group == "Low" & benefit_Target30_group != "Low"),
    pct_Green30_blue_resolved = if_else(
      n_blue_Green30 > 0, 100 * n_blue_resolved / n_blue_Green30, NA_real_
    ),
    n_new_blue = sum(benefit_Green30_group != "Low" & benefit_Target30_group == "Low"),
    additional_deaths_averted = sum(delta_cases),
    pct_change_deaths_averted = 100 * (sum(cases_Target30) / sum(cases_Green30) - 1),
    population_2021_high_vulnerability = if (has_population) sum(population_2021) else NA_real_,
    population_weighted_pct_blue_Green30 = if (has_population) {
      100 * weighted.mean(benefit_Green30_group == "Low", population_2021)
    } else NA_real_,
    population_weighted_pct_blue_Target30 = if (has_population) {
      100 * weighted.mean(benefit_Target30_group == "Low", population_2021)
    } else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    population_weighted_change_blue_percentage_points =
      population_weighted_pct_blue_Target30 - population_weighted_pct_blue_Green30,
    population_year = population_year,
    temperature_period = temperature_period,
    benefit_unit = benefit_unit,
    population_source = population_source
  )

citywide_results <- equity_wide %>%
  summarise(
    deaths_averted_Green30 = sum(cases_Green30),
    deaths_averted_Target30 = sum(cases_Target30),
    difference = deaths_averted_Target30 - deaths_averted_Green30,
    Target30_retention_pct = 100 * deaths_averted_Target30 / deaths_averted_Green30
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    population_year = population_year,
    temperature_period = temperature_period,
    interpretation = "2050 temperature scenarios evaluated with fixed 2021 population and 2021 baseline mortality"
  )

transition_results <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability) %>%
  count(metric, metric_label, benefit_Green30_group, benefit_Target30_group, name = "n_LSOA") %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label, benefit_Green30_group) %>%
  mutate(pct_within_Green30_class = 100 * n_LSOA / sum(n_LSOA)) %>%
  ungroup()

blue_transitions <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability, benefit_Green30_group == "Low") %>%
  count(metric, metric_label, benefit_Target30_group, name = "n_LSOA") %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label) %>%
  complete(
    benefit_Target30_group = factor(benefit_levels, levels = benefit_levels),
    fill = list(n_LSOA = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_LSOA / sum(n_LSOA)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Paired-bootstrap sensitivity intervals

```{r bootstrap}
# Resampling keeps each LSOA's two scenario values paired. These intervals test
# robustness to neighborhood composition; they do not propagate model-input
# uncertainty because LSOA-level health-model draws are not currently retained.
set.seed(bootstrap_seed)
bootstrap_results <- map_dfr(vulnerability_vars, function(metric_name) {
  dat <- metric_data %>% filter(metric == metric_name, high_vulnerability)
  n_dat <- nrow(dat)
  draws <- map_dfr(seq_len(bootstrap_draws), function(draw_id) {
    sampled <- dat[sample.int(n_dat, n_dat, replace = TRUE), ]
    tibble(
      draw = draw_id,
      pct_blue_Green30 = 100 * mean(sampled$benefit_Green30_group == "Low"),
      pct_blue_Target30 = 100 * mean(sampled$benefit_Target30_group == "Low")
    ) %>%
      mutate(change_blue_percentage_points = pct_blue_Target30 - pct_blue_Green30)
  })
  draws %>%
    summarise(
      metric = metric_name,
      metric_label = unname(vulnerability_labels[metric_name]),
      pct_blue_Green30_low = quantile(pct_blue_Green30, 0.025),
      pct_blue_Green30_high = quantile(pct_blue_Green30, 0.975),
      pct_blue_Target30_low = quantile(pct_blue_Target30, 0.025),
      pct_blue_Target30_high = quantile(pct_blue_Target30, 0.975),
      change_low = quantile(change_blue_percentage_points, 0.025),
      change_high = quantile(change_blue_percentage_points, 0.975),
      bootstrap_draws = bootstrap_draws,
      bootstrap_seed = bootstrap_seed
    )
})

headline_results <- headline_results %>%
  left_join(bootstrap_results, by = c("metric", "metric_label")) %>%
  mutate(
    uncertainty_scope = paste(
      "Paired LSOA bootstrap sensitivity interval; excludes uncertainty in",
      "temperature, population, baseline mortality, and exposure-response"
    )
  )
```

## Investigation of the age ≥75 result

```{r age75-diagnostics}
# This tests whether the age-≥75 pattern follows the targeting dimensions. It
# is descriptive, not causal; the population-normalized rerun is still needed.
age75_data <- metric_data %>% filter(metric == "p75over")
age75_group_summary <- age75_data %>%
  group_by(high_age75 = high_vulnerability) %>%
  summarise(
    n_LSOA = n(),
    deaths_averted_Green30 = sum(cases_Green30),
    deaths_averted_Target30 = sum(cases_Target30),
    difference = sum(delta_cases),
    mean_LSOA_difference = mean(delta_cases),
    median_LSOA_difference = median(delta_cases),
    share_with_greater_Target30_benefit = 100 * mean(delta_cases > 0),
    pct_low_benefit_Green30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Green30_group == "Low"),
    pct_low_benefit_Target30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Target30_group == "Low"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(benefit_unit = benefit_unit, population_normalized = has_population)

age75_correlations <- equity_wide %>%
  summarise(
    cor_age75_income_deprivation = cor(p75over, pIncomeDeprivation),
    cor_age75_ethnic_minority = cor(p75over, pBAME),
    cor_age75_SVI = cor(p75over, SVI),
    cor_age75_Green30_benefit = cor(p75over, benefit_Green30),
    cor_age75_Target30_benefit = cor(p75over, benefit_Target30),
    cor_age75_Target30_minus_Green30 = cor(p75over, delta_benefit)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = "Pearson correlation",
    interpretation = "Descriptive diagnostic; rerun with 2021 population-normalized benefit"
  )

age75_transition_summary <- age75_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability) %>%
  count(benefit_Green30_group, benefit_Target30_group, name = "n_LSOA") %>%
  group_by(benefit_Green30_group) %>%
  mutate(pct_within_Green30_class = 100 * n_LSOA / sum(n_LSOA)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Optional model uncertainty for citywide totals

```{r model-uncertainty}
# Matching seeds give both scenarios the same sequence of RR draws, allowing a
# paired difference. The model stores excess deaths, hence the sign reversal.
citywide_uncertainty <- tibble()
if (file.exists(green30_mc_file) && file.exists(target30_mc_file)) {
  green_draws <- read_csv(green30_mc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  target_draws <- read_csv(target30_mc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  required_mc_vars <- c("draw", "all_cause")
  if (!all(required_mc_vars %in% names(green_draws)) ||
      !all(required_mc_vars %in% names(target_draws))) {
    stop("Both Monte Carlo files must contain draw and all_cause columns.")
  }
  paired_draws <- green_draws %>%
    select(draw, Green30_excess = all_cause) %>%
    inner_join(target_draws %>% select(draw, Target30_excess = all_cause), by = "draw") %>%
    mutate(
      Green30_deaths_averted = -Green30_excess,
      Target30_deaths_averted = -Target30_excess,
      difference = Target30_deaths_averted - Green30_deaths_averted
    )
  if (nrow(paired_draws) < 1000) warning("Fewer than 1,000 paired Monte Carlo draws were found.")
  citywide_uncertainty <- paired_draws %>%
    summarise(
      n_paired_draws = n(),
      difference_mean = mean(difference),
      difference_p2p5 = quantile(difference, 0.025),
      difference_p50 = quantile(difference, 0.5),
      difference_p97p5 = quantile(difference, 0.975)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      uncertainty_scope = "Exposure-response RR uncertainty only; temperature and 2021 population/mortality inputs held fixed"
    )
} else {
  message("Add both Monte Carlo draw files under data/derived for citywide model uncertainty.")
}
```

## Figure 7a-b: maps with common thresholds

```{r maps}
main_metric_labels <- unname(vulnerability_labels[main_vulnerability_vars])
geometry_by_lsoa <- health_sf %>%
  select(LSOA11CD) %>%
  group_by(LSOA11CD) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

map_data <- geometry_by_lsoa %>%
  left_join(
    metric_data %>%
      filter(metric %in% main_vulnerability_vars) %>%
      select(
        LSOA11CD, metric_label, vulnerability_class,
        benefit_class_Green30, benefit_class_Target30
      ),
    by = "LSOA11CD"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("benefit_class_"),
    names_to = "scenario", names_prefix = "benefit_class_",
    values_to = "benefit_class"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_keep),
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = main_metric_labels),
    bi_class = paste(vulnerability_class, benefit_class, sep = "-")
  )

map_panels <- map2(c("Green30", "Target30"), c("a", "b"), function(scenario_name, panel_label) {
  scenario_maps <- map(main_metric_labels, function(metric_name) {
    ggplot(map_data %>% filter(scenario == scenario_name, metric_label == metric_name)) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = bi_class), color = NA) +
      bi_scale_fill(pal = "DkCyan", dim = 3) +
      coord_sf(datum = NA) +
      labs(title = paste(scenario_name, metric_name, sep = " · ")) +
      bi_theme(base_size = 8) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1), legend.position = "none"
      )
  })
  plot_grid(plotlist = scenario_maps, nrow = 1, labels = c(panel_label, "", ""), label_size = 11)
})

map_legend <- bi_legend(
  pal = "DkCyan", dim = 3,
  xlab = "Vulnerability", ylab = "Benefit", size = 7
)
fig7_ab_upgraded <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(plot_grid(plotlist = map_panels, ncol = 1), 0, 0.13, 1, 0.87) +
  draw_plot(map_legend, 0.39, 0.005, 0.22, 0.16)
```

## Figure 7c-d: paired comparison and transitions

```{r comparison-plots}
blue_plot_data <- headline_results %>%
  filter(metric %in% main_vulnerability_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = rev(main_metric_labels)),
    change_label = sprintf(
      "%+.1f pp [%+.1f, %+.1f]",
      change_blue_percentage_points, change_low, change_high
    )
  )
blue_transition_plot_data <- blue_transitions %>%
  filter(metric %in% main_vulnerability_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = rev(main_metric_labels)),
    benefit_Target30_group = factor(benefit_Target30_group, levels = benefit_levels)
  )

citywide_note <- sprintf(
  "Citywide deaths averted: Green30 %.1f; Target30 %.1f (%+.1f%%)",
  citywide_results$deaths_averted_Green30,
  citywide_results$deaths_averted_Target30,
  100 * (citywide_results$deaths_averted_Target30 / citywide_results$deaths_averted_Green30 - 1)

p_blue_gap <- ggplot(blue_plot_data, aes(y = metric_label)) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 1.05),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7.5)
  )

p_blue_transition <- ggplot(
  blue_transition_plot_data,
  aes(y = metric_label, x = pct, fill = benefit_Target30_group)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(pct >= 7, paste0(round(pct), "%\n(n=", n_LSOA, ")"), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE), size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Low = "#3B77A6", Moderate = "#86C5B5", High = "#006D5B"),
    labels = c(
      Low = "Remained low benefit",
      Moderate = "Shifted to moderate benefit",
      High = "Shifted to high benefit"
    ), drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Target30 outcomes for the same Green30 low-benefit LSOAs",
    subtitle = "Each bar totals 100%; labels report within-bar percentages and LSOA counts.",
    x = "Distribution under Target30", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 10, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

fig7_cd_upgraded <- plot_grid(
  p_blue_gap, p_blue_transition, labels = c("c", "d"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1.08, 1), label_size = 11
)
```

## Save publication outputs and audit metadata

```{r save-outputs}
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(headline_results, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_quantitative_headline_results.csv"))
write_csv(transition_results, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_paired_transition_matrix.csv"))
write_csv(citywide_results, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_citywide_tradeoff.csv"))
write_csv(age75_group_summary, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_age75_group_summary.csv"))
write_csv(age75_correlations, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_age75_correlations.csv"))
write_csv(age75_transition_summary, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_age75_transition_summary.csv"))
if (nrow(citywide_uncertainty) > 0) {
  write_csv(citywide_uncertainty, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_citywide_uncertainty.csv"))
}

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "fig7_ab_upgraded.png"), fig7_ab_upgraded,
  width = 7, height = 6.2, dpi = 600, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "fig7_cd_upgraded.png"), fig7_cd_upgraded,
  width = 7, height = 6.8, dpi = 600, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
)
for (extension in c("pdf", "svg")) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0("fig7_ab_upgraded.", extension)),
    fig7_ab_upgraded, width = 7, height = 6.2, bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0("fig7_cd_upgraded.", extension)),
    fig7_cd_upgraded, width = 7, height = 6.8, bg = "white"
  )
}

run_metadata <- tibble(
  run_timestamp_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
  outcome = outcome_keep,
  scenarios = paste(scenario_keep, collapse = ";"),
  n_paired_LSOA = nrow(equity_wide),
  population_year = population_year,
  temperature_period = temperature_period,
  population_source = population_source,
  health_zonal_source = health_zonal_file,
  svi_source = svi_file,
  benefit_unit = benefit_unit,
  green30_tertile_1 = green30_benefit_breaks[1],
  green30_tertile_2 = green30_benefit_breaks[2],
  bootstrap_draws = bootstrap_draws,
  bootstrap_seed = bootstrap_seed
)
write_csv(run_metadata, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_run_metadata.csv"))
session_info_lines <- sub(
  "[[:space:]]+$", "", capture.output(sessionInfo())
)
writeLines(session_info_lines, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_session_info.txt"))

# A compact checksum table makes it possible to verify that a manuscript
# figure and its exact inputs/outputs still match after files are copied.
input_paths <- c(
  population_file, health_zonal_file, green30_mc_file, target30_mc_file,
  svi_file
)
output_paths <- file.path(output_dir, c(
  "fig7_quantitative_headline_results.csv",
  "fig7_paired_transition_matrix.csv",
  "fig7_citywide_tradeoff.csv",
  "fig7_age75_group_summary.csv",
  "fig7_age75_correlations.csv",
  "fig7_age75_transition_summary.csv",
  "fig7_run_metadata.csv",
  "fig7_session_info.txt",
  "fig7_ab_upgraded.png", "fig7_ab_upgraded.pdf", "fig7_ab_upgraded.svg",
  "fig7_cd_upgraded.png", "fig7_cd_upgraded.pdf", "fig7_cd_upgraded.svg"
))
if (file.exists(file.path(output_dir, "fig7_citywide_uncertainty.csv"))) {
  output_paths <- c(
    output_paths, file.path(output_dir, "fig7_citywide_uncertainty.csv")
  )
}
manifest_paths <- c(input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)], output_paths)
write_csv(
  tibble(
    role = c(
      rep("input", sum(file.exists(input_paths))),
      rep("output", length(output_paths))
    ),
    path = manifest_paths,
    sha256 = map_chr(
      manifest_paths, ~ digest(file = .x, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
    )
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "fig7_file_manifest.csv")
)

print(headline_results)
print(citywide_results)
print(age75_group_summary)
print(age75_correlations)
if (interactive()) {
  print(fig7_ab_upgraded)
  print(fig7_cd_upgraded)
}
```
